{{Quote|It cannot be destroyed, even by the Emperor's great Death Star.|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
The '''gravity gun''' was a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] designed by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] prior to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. It fired powerful [[gravity bomb]] projectiles that were able to destroy even a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This exotic superweapon appears in the novel ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''.
